title: EventBus unregister after full registry clear contract

contract.full_clear: Sequential unregister operations can remove all listeners for an event
contract.empty_registry: After the final listener is removed the event registry remains empty
contract.repeated_unregister: Unregistering an already removed callback returns False
contract.registry_stability: Repeated unregister against an empty registry does not recreate or modify listener entries
contract.post_clear_emit: Emit succeeds with an empty listener registry
contract.no_delivery: No callback is delivered after the listener registry has been fully cleared
contract.permission_enforcement: Unregister and emit operations continue to require the events permission
